t: You're looking at the Royal Automobile Club, a private social and athletic club at 89 Pall Mall. It has a second clubhouse in the countryside at Woodcote Park, near Epsom, and both offer accommodation, dining and sporting facilities. The club was founded by Frederick Richard Simms, a Germany-born British engineer and motor industry pioneer who worked with Gottlieb Daimler and Robert Bosch. Simms is credited with coining the words petrol and motorcar.
